newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' prices mixed, trading volumes low.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' prices mixed, trading volumes low.

text.p: Indian metals' prices were mixed on Tuesday on low trading volumes as major players kept away awaiting the new selling price list by state firms, dealers said.
Nickel slid by 200 rupees to 37,800 rupees on lower demand as importers booked profits. It rose by 300 rupees last week.
Copper was unchanged at 11,750 rupees, zinc at 6,200 rupees and lead at 4,925 rupees in a narrow price band. Tin was steady at 35,600 rupees and aluminium at 7,250 rupees.
